needed.evidence: Informal path under 1m and partly blocked by parked vehicles and street vendors.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, usable sidewalk with a minimum width of 1.5 metres along the right side of the road from the evident obstruction points.

needed.evidence: Obstructions from parked vehicles and street setups on the informal path.
needed.suggestion: Remove all obstructions on the right side informal path to ensure it is fully accessible for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Uneven and broken sections on the informal path.
needed.suggestion: Repair the uneven and broken sections on the right side informal path to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: Crossing demand exists due to shops and buildings on both sides but no crossing facility visible.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing at least at the busy intersections to facilitate safe crossing for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Visible street lighting is insufficient for urban road safety.
needed.suggestion: Install additional street lights along this road to improve night-time visibility and safety.
